P1_derating_only_at_mixed_duration_nodes.source: Planner task (S56 step 0) / S56_PLAN_v2.md step 0 key prediction
P1_derating_only_at_mixed_duration_nodes.statement: derating < 1 only at nodes with mixed-duration cohorts
P1_derating_only_at_mixed_duration_nodes.operationalised: (a) node-year level: L/sum s < 1 iff the active cohorts of that node-year have at least two distinct E/P durations; (b) plan level: a plan has some node-year ratio < 1 iff it has >= 1 mixed-duration node. Exact rational arithmetic on the granule integers.

P2_2025_TV_zero.operationalised: on both grids: rlf(2025) == 0 exactly; on a built ESSO with only a 2025 cohort and in_objective on, the salvage credit expression has no variable and constant 0.0, and the reporting salvage expression evaluates to 0.0 at two synthetic terminal SoH values

P3_converter_residual_per_0p25_MVA.operationalised: disc_T * E_m[c^S(y)] * rlf(y) * 0.25 MVA, pro-rata calendar life, installation-year expected converter cost, discounted from the horizon end like S; "~" read as within +-10 % (Worker operationalisation, declared here before computing)
